_comment: Human-owned acceptance constants for the gate config. Vignan edits these, then runs `uv run python scripts/sign_config.py` to pin the three catalogs and sign. The script fills in the code-derived digests (gate library, control catalog, the three catalogs); do NOT add those by hand.
_mie_note: mde (0.005) is the DETECTABILITY floor. mie_floor (0.01) is the INTEREST floor and must stay strictly above mde. RESOLVED (2026-07-30): runner.py now reads the signed per-task mie_distribution value via referee.catalog.resolve_mie, flowing through bundle.mie, and mie_floor is only the FALLBACK for a task with no signed entry. Hand-setting mie_floor per campaign is no longer needed. Per-task MIEs live in the signed catalog (SSv2 0.01, K400 0.011, tomato_temporal_mcq 0.03).
